populations.context: Retained selected unchanged source module, not the complete upstream application. Evaluator go.mod adds cached OpenTracing1.2.0. No source stubs or application edits. Upstream source commit is provenance only, never the generated SCIP evaluation commit.
Evaluator-authored Go tags and IDL controls. Header imitates supported recipe for controlled recognition; no real Apache generator execution or independent public accuracy is claimed.

oracle.rule: Complete lexical identifier census in exactly selected handwritten application files; all exact tagged-field uses manually enumerated before any index/extractor execution. Comments/strings excluded except one explicitly unsupported reflection string. Generated emissions counted separately and excluded from public/neutral quality denominators.
oracle.independence: No SCIP, candidate facts, production extractor/parser or observed result consulted. Tokenizer only locates frozen source spans for explicit field maps. Lead verifies source/code/IDL witnesses independently.

thresholds.unknown_indexer_symbol_shape: stop; do not relabel source oracle
thresholds.generated_emissions: record separately; every returned generated occurrence must still satisfy citation and source-authority fences

execution_plan.phase1: Independent source-only checkpoint before indexing; no candidate/scoring permitted
execution_plan.phase2: When native slot allocated, at most one offline real scip-go child at a time, <=90s per public/neutral input, GOPROXY=off GOSUMDB=off GOTOOLCHAIN=local GOWORK=off GOMAXPROCS=2, no network dependency download. Record exact argv/context/indexed document census/bytes/digests/refusal and child join.
execution_plan.phase3: Lead creates actual local evaluation Git source+index commits/bundles; upstream-vs-evaluator bytes remain explicit. Bind40hex evaluation commits and bundle/index hashes before candidate review.
execution_plan.phase4: Only after corrected final preregistration accepted: one <=30s child-free extraction/scoring run using committed inputs; preserve every miss/extra/unsupported failure, no post-result labels/threshold changes.
